name: 232. parallel_tool_calls=false reaches Claude as disable_parallel_tool_use (parallel tool use)
description: Customer report: parallel_tool_calls: false (and Anthropic tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use) was dropped on the way to Claude on Bedrock, so Claude still answered with several tool calls in one turn. Bedrock Converse has no typed field for it: the only spelling it accepts is a typeless additionalModelRequestFields.tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use next to toolConfig.toolChoice (a type there is a ValidationException); with server tools only it carries its own type, and a pinned server tool carries it on the tunneled choice. Per Anthropic, the flag with auto means at most one tool call and with any/tool exactly one, so auto rows assert at most one plus the wire, and forced rows assert exactly one. Native /bedrock routes echo no raw_request, so their forced rows carry the proof. 232.1-232.5 replay the customer report (Sonnet 5 / Opus 5 on /v1/responses and /anthropic). The rest cover every route that reaches Claude: Bedrock Converse on chat, chat stream, Responses, Responses stream and /anthropic; tool_choice omitted/auto/required/pinned/none; reasoning; tools rebuilt from history; server tools; the InvokeModel path a deferred tool takes; native /bedrock InvokeModel and Converse; Nova (no flag); and Anthropic direct.
